messages:
alex kim: Proposal: cut RC from main -> rc/2025-07-02-candidate. Build id `2025.1745`. Requesting QA + ops signoff for promo window 09:00-11:00 UTC tomorrow. Pin artifact sha: `abcdef1234`. Planned rollout: canary 2% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over ~45m. @maria gonzalez @jamal singh can you eyeball?

maria gonzalez: starting e2e against the candidate now. will report failures. running stage smoke + full e2e. kv-warm plan: preheat KV via `scripts/kv_preheat.sh`.

jamal singh: reserving the 09:00 slot and on-call for the window. can we keep fallback to `prod-stable` if we see perf regressions? also confirm: no DB migrations in this cut, right?

alex kim: no DB migrations. fallback policy in deploy config will be: `route.primary=rc-candidate, route.fallback=prod-stable`. pin command: `deploybot pin artifact abcdef1234 --team infra`

deploy-bot: Pin acknowledged for artifact `abcdef1234`. Ticket DPL-785 created. To schedule promotion run: `deploybot promote --pin abcdef1234 --window 2025-07-02T09:00:00Z/2025-07-02T11:00:00Z`

tanvi rao: QA found intermittent 500s on /login in stage under concurrency. stack: `HTTP 500 at /login -> AuthService::token` reproducible ~2/10 runs. digging in, might be a flake in session shard.

alex kim: okay if auth is a flake only under heavy load, we do a conservative canary: start at 2% and hold until we see stable metrics for 20m. jamal, can you set the canary policy?

jamal singh: yes. will set initial canary 2% for 20m, then 5% for 10m, then 25% for 15m, then full. Alert/rollback conditions: `error_rate > 0.5%` OR `p90_latency > 600ms` -> auto rollback. I'll add alerts.

sheriff liz: SRE ack. i'll take pager for the window. adding deadman switch: `ops deadman 15m` — if no ack in 15m we auto-rollback.

maria gonzalez: e2e green except that auth flake. adding rollback triggers to release config: `rollback_triggers: [auth_http_5xx, p90_latency>600ms, disk_iowait>20%]`

alex kim: I pushed a short release-notes delta in GH: https://git.internal/redwood/releases/rc-2025/delta — includes feature list + known flaky test. Also documented rollback steps in the runbook.

tanvi rao: QA will rerun auth test under a few more synthetic user profiles. if still flaky, i'll push a tiny fix and re-request pin, otherwise give QA thumbs.

jamal singh: ops thumbs if we keep canary at 2% until we see auth stable. I'll post the alert thresholds in #eng-oncall.

sheriff liz: :thumbsup: oncall ready. make sure the oncall rotation is notified.

alex kim: final thumbs? :thumbsup: to proceed with scheduled promo with conservative canary.

tanvi rao: :thumbsup: from QA once I confirm non-blocking.

jamal singh: :thumbsup: ops, ready to promote at 09:00.

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled. Promo ID: PROMO-1745001129. Canary start: 2025-07-02T09:00:00Z at 2%. Notifications: #eng-oncall, #eng-releases. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rc-promo. To cancel: `deploybot cancel PROMO-1745001129`

alex kim: thanks. i'll keep the thread updated through the window. leaving the pinned sha in the ticket. if any of the rollback triggers fire, follow runbook steps and post summary in this thread.

maria gonzalez: noted. will re-run auth tests 30m before the window and report.

jamal singh: adding a short rollback ladder here for docs: 1) `deploybot pause PROMO-1745001129` 2) `deploybot rollback --to prod-stable` 3) if issue persists, roll forward hotfix branch `hotfix/auth-502` -> create new candidate.

alex kim: perfect. closing signoff loop. thanks everyone.
